description: Simple yield model: biomethane = biogas_in * CH4_fraction * CH4_recovery; SEC applied to electrical energy consumption.

unit.name: Generic Biogas Upgrading Unit (PSA/membrane/amine)
unit.source: IEA Bioenergy Task 37 (2017); Bauer et al. (2013) Bioresour. Technol. 122:145

CH4_recovery.note: Fraction of CH4 recovered from raw biogas

SEC_kWh_per_Nm3.note: Specific energy consumption per Nm3 raw biogas

CO2_removal_fraction.note: Fraction of CO2 stripped from biogas
